summary: Published node1’s staged boot directory as a persistent, read-only TFTP root. Node2 successfully downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin byte-for-byte. Uploads, overwrites, traversal, and absolute outside-root requests are rejected. Both nodes retained Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic and recovered successfully after sequential restarts.

Kept the root and approved files root-owned and non-writable by the TFTP service.
Verified successful node2 downloads and matching SHA-256 hashes.

Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and complete recovery after each restart.
